text: For instance, in Canada we use galvanised nails in place of screws. We just bend them over and clamp firmly by using a hammer each side. Over here I've always used brass screws, which are more expensive. The first job is to make your moulds. In Fig. nailed and glued together strongly, it may be marked and cut to shape later. For instance, in Canedor we use galvanised nails instead of screws. We just bend them over and always use more expensive brass screws. The job is to make your moulds. In Fig., they are nailed and glued together strongly, it may be marked and cut to shape later.
name: Peter Aspiotis
